dedupe_keys.name: a global dataset of impact forces from submarine landslides on pipelines and cables

description: A global dataset of impact forces from submarine landslides on pipelines and cables is a data set described in a peer-reviewed Scientific Data article written by Xiaolei Liu et al. Submarine pipelines and cables are critical infrastructure components supporting offshore energy production and global communications. These systems are increasingly at risk from submarine landslides, which can generate significant mechanical forces and compromise structural integrity. Coverage: global; published in 2026. Formats: Excel. The data are held in Figshare and reached through its DOI listed on this page; the paper's Data Records section names it. Size stated by the repository: 204045 Bytes. Access is free of charge and open according to the article. The licence is CC-BY-4.0, taken from DataCite rights of the deposit. Caveats: written from the Scientific Data article metadata (title, abstract, Data Records section) read on 2026-10-01; the data themselves were not opened or downloaded, so their contents, quality and current availability were not checked. It can support transport-network, traffic and mobility studies. Related records: none catalogued yet.
